_meta.source: Researched in Cowork from official and public sources; see pilot-content-review-2026-10.md
_meta.choice_values: human labels from the v2 brief; map to stored keys before import

map_points.name: Porte Saint-Joseph (St. Joseph's Gate)
map_points.note: Main entrance on Place Mgr Laurence, with the statue of St. Joseph. The tourist train and La Merlasse car park are beside it.

map_points.name: Grotto of Massabielle
map_points.note: Where the 18 apparitions took place. The spring is inside, and the route past the Grotto is open to all.

map_points.name: Basilica of the Immaculate Conception
map_points.note: The Upper Basilica, built on the rock above the Grotto. The 1862 declaration is engraved in its right aisle.

map_points.name: Rosary Basilica
map_points.note: The lower basilica, entered from Rosary Square between the two curving ramps.

map_points.name: Basilica of St. Pius X (underground)
map_points.note: Large underground basilica consecrated in 1958, used for the big international Masses.

map_points.name: The Baths (Piscines)
map_points.note: Immersion in spring water, helped by volunteers. Individuals don't book; groups book online. Arrive early.

map_points.name: Way of the Cross (Espélugues hill)
map_points.note: About 1.5 km of stations with life-size figures on a steep hillside. A stone stair leads to the first station.

map_points.name: Le Cachot
map_points.note: The former jail cell at 15 rue des Petits Fossés where Bernadette's family lived in 1858.

map_points.name: Moulin de Boly (Bernadette's birthplace)
map_points.note: The mill on rue Bernadette Soubirous where Bernadette was born in 1844.

map_points.name: Lourdes train station
map_points.note: TGV, Intercités and regional trains. About 20 minutes on foot to the Sanctuary.

map_points.name: Parking du Boissarie
map_points.note: Paid municipal car park near Pont Saint-Michel, a short walk from the Sanctuary.

lodging.name: Hôtel Eliseo
lodging.note: Large hotel on rue Reine Astrid, about 100 m from St. Joseph's Gate by its own account. Lift and rooms adapted for reduced mobility. Seasonal, April to October.

lodging.name: Grand Hôtel Gallia & Londres
lodging.note: Hotel on avenue Bernadette Soubirous, facing the Sanctuary. Lifts and rooms adapted for reduced mobility. Seasonal.

lodging.name: Grand Hôtel Moderne
lodging.note: Hotel on avenue Bernadette Soubirous with a lift and rooms for reduced mobility. Seasonal, late March to early November.

lodging.name: Cité Saint-Pierre (Secours Catholique)
lodging.note: Run by Secours Catholique for pilgrims in hardship, families and church groups, and recommended by the Sanctuary. About 1.5 km away, in a wooded setting.

lodging.name: Centre Assomption Lourdes
lodging.note: Religious house in the tradition of the Assumption Sisters, north of the river. About 170 guests, with a lift. Seasonal, April to November.

pages.title: Our Lady of Medjugorje (Queen of Peace)

map_points.name: St. James Church
map_points.note: The parish church, consecrated in 1969. The main doors face the square with the Queen of Peace statue.

map_points.name: Queen of Peace statue
map_points.note: Marble statue in the square in front of the church.

map_points.name: Risen Christ statue
map_points.note: Bronze statue southwest of the church, with level Stations of the Cross nearby for those who can't climb Cross Mountain.

map_points.name: Blue Cross
map_points.note: At the foot of Apparition Hill, a common starting point for the climb.

map_points.name: Apparition Hill (Podbrdo)
map_points.note: Site of the first reported apparitions in June 1981, marked by a statue of Our Lady. The path is steep and rocky.

map_points.name: Cross Mountain (Križevac), lower path
map_points.note: Near the start of the Way of the Cross path up Križevac. Approximate.

map_points.name: Križevac summit cross
map_points.note: Concrete cross raised in 1934. The rocky climb past 14 bronze Stations takes about 1 to 2 hours.

lodging.name: Hotel Grace
lodging.note: About a 2-minute walk to St. James, on Pape Ivana Pavla II street.

lodging.name: Hotel Leone
lodging.note: About 150 m from St. James by the hotel's own account.

lodging.name: Hotel Luna
lodging.note: Hotel on Fra Slavka Barbarića street, about 10 minutes east of the church. Lift and rooms for guests with disabilities.

lodging.name: Medjugorje Hotel & Spa
lodging.note: Hotel on Fra Slavka Barbarića street, under 1 km from the church. Lists accessible rooms and an elevator.

lodging.name: Ana & Stjepan Nikolić guesthouse
lodging.note: Family guesthouse for pilgrims on Kardinala Stepinca street, about 700 m north of St. James. Cash only.

pages.title: Basilica of St. Francis of Assisi

map_points.name: Lower Church entrance (Piazza Inferiore)
map_points.note: Entrance to the Lower Church, where daily Mass is celebrated. Stairs lead down to the tomb.

map_points.name: Tomb of St. Francis
map_points.note: The plain stone tomb beneath the Lower Church high altar, with four early companions buried nearby. Approximate position.

map_points.name: Porta San Francesco
map_points.note: Old city gate on Viale Marconi, the usual walking approach from the car park.

map_points.name: Piazza Giovanni Paolo II car park
map_points.note: Paid car park, open 24 hours, about 400 m from the Basilica.

map_points.name: Assisi train station (Santa Maria degli Angeli)
map_points.note: On the plain about 3 km below the old town. Buses to the upper town leave from the station square.

map_points.name: Basilica of St. Clare
map_points.note: Tomb of St. Clare and the San Damiano crucifix, at the other end of the old town.

map_points.name: Sanctuary of the Renunciation
map_points.note: Where Francis gave up his possessions, and where St. Carlo Acutis is buried.

map_points.name: San Damiano
map_points.note: Church and convent below the town, reached by a downhill walk.

map_points.name: Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels (Porziuncola)
map_points.note: In Santa Maria degli Angeli, a short walk from the train station.

map_points.name: Eremo delle Carceri
map_points.note: Hermitage on Mount Subasio, about 4 km east of town, uphill.

lodging.name: Hotel Windsor Savoia
lodging.note: Hotel on Viale Marconi beside Porta San Francesco, a few minutes' walk from the Basilica. Lift and adapted rooms.

lodging.name: Hotel San Francesco
lodging.note: On Via San Francesco, facing the Basilica in the pedestrian old town.

lodging.name: Giotto Hotel & Spa
lodging.note: Hotel on Via Fontebella with views over the valley, about 200 m from the Basilica. Some suites are reached only by stairs.

lodging.name: Cittadella Ospitalità (Pro Civitate Christiana)
lodging.note: Guest house of a Catholic lay association on Via degli Ancajani. Lift and adapted rooms in the main building; the annex is reached by stairs.

lodging.name: St. Anthony's Guest House
lodging.note: Run by the Franciscan Sisters of the Atonement, between St. Clare and the Cathedral. Book by email. Closed mid-November to February.

map_points.name: Plaza entrance (Atrio de las Américas)
map_points.note: Pilgrims enter the large plaza from the south. Position approximate, shown at the New Basilica.

map_points.name: Old Basilica (Templo Expiatorio a Cristo Rey)
map_points.note: Opened in 1709 and home to the tilma until 1976. Daily Masses.

map_points.name: Capuchinas parish church
map_points.note: Former convent church of the Capuchin nuns, now the parish church.

map_points.name: Capilla de Indios
map_points.note: Historic chapel at the foot of the hill, linked by tradition to where Juan Diego lived.

map_points.name: Capilla del Pocito
map_points.note: Round 18th-century chapel over a spring that pilgrims believed had healing water.

map_points.name: Capilla del Cerrito (Tepeyac hilltop)
map_points.note: Chapel on the hilltop where, by tradition, Juan Diego gathered the roses. Reached by stairs and paths.

map_points.name: Metro La Villa-Basílica (Line 6)
map_points.note: Closest Metro station, about a 5-minute walk south. Service may be limited around December 11–12.

map_points.name: Metro Deportivo 18 de Marzo (Lines 3 and 6)
map_points.note: Transfer station for travelers coming from the Zócalo on Line 3. About 1 km on foot.

lodging.name: Hotel Único La Villa
lodging.note: On Calzada de Guadalupe, the closest hotel to the shrine. No elevator; upper floors by stairs only.

lodging.name: Hotel Via La Villa
lodging.note: On Avenida FC Hidalgo in Guadalupe Tepeyac, about 2 km away. Elevator, listed as easy to access by wheelchair.

lodging.name: City Express by Marriott Ciudad de México La Villa
lodging.note: On Calzada de Guadalupe. Elevators and accessible rooms with roll-in showers. A taxi or Metro ride rather than a walk.

lodging.name: Holiday Inn Express Mexico Basilica
lodging.note: Calzada de Guadalupe 54, south of the shrine. Elevator and accessible rooms. A short taxi ride to the Basilica.

map_points.name: Sanctuary esplanade
map_points.note: The Sanctuary has no single gate and is open day and night. Marked near the Basilica of the Rosary.

map_points.name: Chapel of the Apparitions (Capelinha)
map_points.note: Site of five of the six 1917 apparitions. The statue's base marks where the small holm oak stood.

map_points.name: Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary
map_points.note: Tombs of St. Jacinta and Sister Lúcia in one transept, St. Francisco in the other.

map_points.name: Basilica of the Most Holy Trinity
map_points.note: Large round church dedicated in 2007. Confession chapels and the Blessed Sacrament Chapel are on the lower level.

map_points.name: Loca do Cabeço
map_points.note: Where the angel visited the children in 1916, marked by statues of the angel and the three children.

map_points.name: Hungarian Calvary (end of the Way of the Cross)
map_points.note: The 14 stations lead here; the Valinhos monument to the August 1917 apparition stands along the way.

map_points.name: Aljustrel (homes of the seers)
map_points.note: Houses of Lúcia and of the Marto family. Free, open daily. About 30 minutes on foot from the Sanctuary.

map_points.name: Fátima bus terminal
map_points.note: Express buses from Lisbon. Position from the Shrine's 2017 map; check before relying on it.

lodging.name: Domus Pacis Fátima Hotel
lodging.note: Founded as the international center of the Blue Army (World Apostolate of Fatima). Two chapels, a lift and a stair-free entrance.

lodging.name: Retreat House of Our Lady of Mount Carmel (Casa Carmo)
lodging.note: Run by the Shrine, on the south side of the Prayer Area. 119 rooms, breakfast and a private chapel. Book at booking.fatima.pt.

lodging.name: Retreat House of Our Lady of Sorrows (Casa Dores)
lodging.note: Run by the Shrine, on the north side of the Prayer Area. 83 rooms, 44 adapted for guests with disabilities.

lodging.name: Paul VI Pastoral Centre
lodging.note: Run by the Shrine, west of the Basilica of the Most Holy Trinity. Aimed at groups and retreats, with a chapel and canteen.

map_points.name: Visitor arrival point (North Car Park)
map_points.note: The point the Shrine gives for drivers and coaches, on the Ballyhaunis Road. Free parking.

map_points.name: Apparition Chapel and gable wall
map_points.note: Encloses the gable of the 1828 parish church where the 1879 apparition was seen. Open daily.

map_points.name: Knock Parish Church
map_points.note: The 1828 church whose gable wall was the backdrop of the apparition. Many weekday Masses are here.

map_points.name: Basilica of Our Lady, Queen of Ireland
map_points.note: Dedicated in 1976 and made a basilica in 1979. Main Sunday Masses in pilgrimage season.

map_points.name: Knock Museum
map_points.note: The story of the 1879 apparition and rural life of the time. Free, open daily. A good place to start.

map_points.name: West Car Park
map_points.note: Behind the stalls area, with electric-vehicle charging.

lodging.name: St Mary's, Knock
lodging.note: Run by Knock Shrine, beside the grounds on Main Street. 50 en-suite rooms and an oratory. Closed in winter.

lodging.name: Knock House Hotel
lodging.note: 68 rooms, 6 of them wheelchair accessible. The hotel says it is under a 5-minute walk from the Shrine and Basilica.

lodging.name: The Retreat Village at Knock Shrine
lodging.note: Self-catering en-suite pods on the Shrine grounds, run by Knock Shrine for retreats. Book with the manager.

lodging.name: Carramore House
lodging.note: Bed and breakfast approved by Fáilte Ireland, about 800 m from the Shrine. Private parking.

map_points.name: Security entrance, St. Peter's Square
map_points.note: Security checks under the right-hand colonnade, with a reserved ramp entrance for people with disabilities. Position approximate.

map_points.name: Altar of the Confession and Tomb of St. Peter
map_points.note: The papal altar under Bernini's canopy stands over Peter's traditional grave.

map_points.name: Excavations Office (Scavi)
map_points.note: Tours of the necropolis to Peter's tomb, booked well ahead on the official site.

map_points.name: Ottaviano (Metro Line A)
map_points.note: Closest metro stop, about a 10 to 15 minute walk to the square.

map_points.name: Roma San Pietro station
map_points.note: Regional rail station about 300 m from the basilica.

lodging.name: Domus Carmelitana
lodging.note: Guesthouse in a former Carmelite house on Via Alberico II, overseen by the Carmelite Order. Lift and an accessible route.

lodging.name: Casa per Ferie Santa Maria alle Fornaci
lodging.note: Guesthouse beside the Trinitarian church of Santa Maria alle Fornaci, near San Pietro station. Has a lift; ask about steps at the entrance.

lodging.name: Hotel Columbus
lodging.note: Hotel in a historic palace on Via della Conciliazione, the avenue that leads straight to St. Peter's Square.

lodging.name: Hotel Casa Tra Noi
lodging.note: Large house for pilgrims and groups, with two chapels. Uphill on Monte del Gallo, so the walk back is steep. Lift.

map_points.name: Main facade, Piazza di Porta San Giovanni
map_points.note: The great east facade. Two ramps on the forecourt and lifts in the portico give step-free entry.

map_points.name: Scala Santa and Sancta Sanctorum
map_points.note: Across the square. Tradition says these steps came from Pilate's palace; pilgrims climb them on their knees.

map_points.name: Lateran Baptistery
map_points.note: Rome's ancient eight-sided baptistery, from the 5th century. Free to enter.

map_points.name: San Giovanni (Metro Lines A and C)
map_points.note: Just outside Porta San Giovanni, a few minutes' walk to the facade.

lodging.name: Domus Sessoriana
lodging.nearest_point: Main facade, Piazza di Porta San Giovanni
lodging.note: Guesthouse in the former monastery of the Basilica of the Holy Cross in Jerusalem. Pilgrims welcome. Position shown at the basilica.

lodging.name: Casa per Ferie Domus Helena
lodging.nearest_point: Main facade, Piazza di Porta San Giovanni
lodging.note: 36-room guesthouse on Via Ferruccio, with a lift and step-free route.

lodging.name: Saint John Hotel
lodging.nearest_point: Main facade, Piazza di Porta San Giovanni
lodging.note: Hotel on Via Matteo Boiardo, a short walk north of the basilica.

lodging.name: Casa per Ferie Carmelite Teresian Sisters
lodging.nearest_point: Main facade, Piazza di Porta San Giovanni
lodging.note: Run by Carmelite sisters at Via Tasso 157, near the metro. No accessible facilities listed. Book through ospitalitareligiosa.it.

map_points.name: Main entrance, Piazza di Santa Maria Maggiore
map_points.note: Main doors under the portico, with a ramp to the right. Security check; large bags may be refused. Position approximate.

map_points.name: Liberian Museum, Loggia and excavations
map_points.note: One ticket covers the museum, the Loggia of Blessings, the Bernini staircase and the excavations.

map_points.name: Column of Peace (Marian column)
map_points.note: Column topped by a statue of Mary in the square in front of the basilica.

map_points.name: Roma Termini
map_points.note: Rome's main station, metro Lines A and B. About a 10-minute walk.

map_points.name: Vittorio Emanuele (Metro Line A)
map_points.note: About 550 m southeast of the basilica.

map_points.name: Cavour (Metro Line B)
map_points.note: About 500 m west. Line B runs directly to Basilica San Paolo.

lodging.name: Casa per Ferie Suore di Santa Elisabetta
lodging.nearest_point: Main entrance, Piazza di Santa Maria Maggiore
lodging.note: Guesthouse run by sisters, about 125 m from the basilica. Lift, chapel, terrace and an 11 pm curfew. Pay on site only.

lodging.name: Mecenate Palace Hotel
lodging.nearest_point: Main entrance, Piazza di Santa Maria Maggiore
lodging.note: Hotel on Via Carlo Alberto, about 120 m from the basilica. Listed as accessible, with a lift.

lodging.name: Hotel Montreal
lodging.nearest_point: Main entrance, Piazza di Santa Maria Maggiore
lodging.note: Hotel on Via Carlo Alberto, about 200 m from the basilica toward Termini. Lift.

lodging.name: Suore Concezioniste Missionarie
lodging.nearest_point: Main entrance, Piazza di Santa Maria Maggiore
lodging.note: Sisters' guesthouse on Via Bixio near Piazza Vittorio, about 900 m east of the basilica.

pages.title: Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls

map_points.name: Quadriporticus entrance
map_points.note: The colonnaded forecourt before the west facade, facing the Tiber. Position approximate.

map_points.name: Basilica San Paolo (Metro Line B)
map_points.note: Behind the basilica. Line B runs direct from Termini and Cavour.

map_points.name: San Paolo alle Tre Fontane
map_points.note: About 2.7 km south: the church built where tradition says Paul was beheaded, part of the Trappist abbey.

map_points.name: Porta San Paolo
map_points.note: Ancient city gate on the Via Ostiense, about 2 km north. Pilgrims can walk the old road from here to Paul's tomb.

lodging.name: San Paolo Guest House
lodging.note: Small private guesthouse near the Basilica San Paolo metro.

lodging.name: Palazzo Senesi
lodging.note: Registered guesthouse on Via Ostiense, about 600 m north of the basilica.

lodging.name: Abitart Hotel
lodging.note: Hotel in the Ostiense district at Via Pellegrino Matteucci 10, near Piramide metro, two stops from Basilica San Paolo.
